newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dow's fall tips Singapore shares lower at open.
newsitem.headline: Dow's fall tips Singapore shares lower at open.

text.p: The Singapore stock market drifted lower in early Friday trade after Wall Street's slide overnight. Dealers said extremely thin volumes limited the downside in Singapore.
At 0215 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index was down 12.29 points at 2,170.26 after opening at 2,181.28. Turnover was extremely thin around 23 million, with losers leading gainers by 135 to 19.
"There are not many sellers. Also, not many fresh positions had been taken recently. I see this market consolidating for now with a greater downward bias," said one local dealer.
He added most major houses had already closed their books and he expected window-dressing only to stream in during the last week of the year.
Printed circuit board maker Wong's Circuits topped the actives with 4.8 million shares. It dipped US$0.02 to US$0.975.
Profit-taking dampened blue chips like DBS foreign and City Developments which fell Singapore $0.40 (US$0.29) and S$0.30 respectively.
Multimedia firm Creative led gainers, rising S$0.60 to S$14.60 on the back of improved sentiment on its earnings.
L&M, which was suspended since last Friday, resumed trading and fell S$0.13 to $1.60 on 760,000 shares.
